compiled_state.title: Per-Story LLM Review: review executes before review defense comments are mirrored to PR -> story-scoped reviewer cannot account for existing defenses
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** 5c86dc821eb6969a25aeb817859b8da270243bcb

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior

The per-story / Sprint Story Review CI job should run AFTER review defense comments are mirrored to the PR (i.e., after `mirror-defenses-to-pr.sh` completes), so the story-scoped reviewer can see existing defenses and avoid re-raising findings that have already been defended.

The `llm-review` job has a `needs: [mirror-tracker-defenses]` dependency (or equivalent) that ensures defenses are visible before review. The Per-Story LLM Review job should have the same prerequisite ordering.

#### Actual Behavior

The Per-Story LLM Review (Sprint Story Review) CI job starts immediately on push, with no dependency on the defense-mirroring step. As a result, the story-scoped reviewer operates without visibility into defenses recorded by `review-defense-store.sh` and mirrored by `mirror-defenses-to-pr.sh`, causing it to re-raise already-defended findings as new critical or important issues.

### 5. Skills and Workflows

* CI workflow: `.github/workflows/sprint-story-review.yml` (Per-Story LLM Review job)
* Defense mirroring: `plugins/dso/scripts/mirror-defenses-to-pr.sh`
* Defense store: `plugins/dso/scripts/review-defense-store.sh`
* Reference: `plugins/dso/docs/CI-INTEGRATION.md` (two-channel review architecture)
